# Test fixtures

These fixtures reproduce observed popup/episode-navigation behavior for regression tests; they are not included in the packaged extension.

- `chophim-module.js`: a small functional excerpt of the public click-popunder handler from `https://chophim.lol/_next/static/chunks/2ceb5394e21bed6c.js`, captured November 12, 2026.
- `mflix-popup.js`: decoded public popup behavior from `https://mflix.store/assets/pu.js`, captured November 12–13, 2026.
- `phimhdcss-no-link.js`: the episode-navigation function from `https://phimhdcss.com/js/hdc-common-ui.js`, captured November 13, 2026.
- `phimhdcss-jquery.js`: jQuery, MIT licensed; the original license header is preserved. See `JQUERY-LICENSE.txt`.

Full downloaded HTML snapshots and unrelated site bundles are not published in this repository.
